text: Aisha and Obi got engaged on Saturday night at the restaurant where they had their first date. She said he was shaking so much he nearly dropped the ring. They're thinking of a summer wedding next year, probably in Lagos so his grandmother can come. Aisha already has a spreadsheet going, of course. Must get them a bottle of something good before I see them on Thursday evening.
Housewarming at Theo's new flat is Friday at 7pm. I'm bringing the cheese board. Need to grab a plant for him on the way, something hard to kill.
Gintaras has a viewing on a two-bed in Leith tomorrow morning at 10. He's nervous because the last three fell through. Text him that afternoon to see how it went.
Shira and Santiago's tenth anniversary is on the 14th. They're doing a quiet dinner at home rather than a party.
Called Mum. Auntie Angela's sixtieth has been moved to Sunday the 3rd at 1pm, same pub as before.
Alina mentioned she's moving to Lisbon in January for work. Her boyfriend Louis is staying here until the summer, then joining her. She seemed excited but a bit overwhelmed by the paperwork.
Simone's wedding is officially off. She and Callum split up last month and she's only just started telling people. Don't push it, just keep inviting her to things.
Jaya loves anything with saffron in it. Allergic to walnuts, so no baklava.
Björn invited me to his fortieth on the 22nd. It's a ceilidh in the village hall, starting at 8.
Must book the van for the move by Thursday. Removal day is the 30th at 9am, keys from the agent the day before.
Mariam's sister Laila is getting married in Karachi in February. The whole family is flying out a week before, and Mariam is stressing about the mehndi outfits.
Beatriz Barros, Bea to everyone at work, is hosting a leaving do for Kaito on Friday after work. I should chip in for the card and the gift.
Aleksander and his wife have finally sold the house. Completion is on the 18th and they move into the new place the next day. He said the kids are already arguing over bedrooms.

Aditi's cat Pickle went missing during the move last week. They found him two days later hiding under the neighbour's shed. Ask her how he's settling in. The new house backs onto a field, so she's worried he'll keep wandering off. She's thinking about one of those GPS collars and asked if I knew anyone who'd tried them.
Dinner at Elijah's on Saturday at half 7. His partner Ava is cooking, and apparently she's vegan now, so no point bringing the good salami.
Mustafa got the flat in Manchester! Signs the lease on Monday morning and moves in a fortnight later. He's been looking since June.
Chantal is anxious about hosting her in-laws for their anniversary lunch next Sunday. She's never cooked for more than four people. Offer to help her with the prep the day before.

Dong said his parents are celebrating forty years married on 2 November. He wants to surprise them with a framed photo from their wedding day, so I'm digging out my scanner for him. His sister Mariam is organising a meal at their favourite Chinese place that evening and wants it kept quiet until the starters arrive. Dong is useless at secrets, so fingers crossed.
Adebayo's engagement party is on the 9th at 6pm at his uncle's place in Peckham. Dress code is traditional if you have it. Remember to ask Obi if he wants to share a cab.
Chiara hinted she'd love a proper set of copper pans for the new kitchen. Worth remembering for Christmas.
Jasmine moved into her own place on Sunday, first time living alone. She said the first night was weirdly quiet. Check in with her at the weekend.
Sana is applying for a flat share in Bristol and has a video call with the current tenants on Wednesday at 4.
Lunch with Kaito. He's been at the architecture firm for two years now and is thinking about going freelance. His fiancée Naledi works in the same building.
Ellie and Theo are hosting a joint birthday barbecue on the 5th, weather permitting. If it rains it moves to the 12th at the same time.
Pick up the dry cleaning before 5 and post the rent cheque. Bins go out tonight.

Naledi said the wedding venue had double-booked them for 20 June, so they've moved everything to the 27th. She spent all morning on the phone to the caterers and the florist afterwards. Send her something nice, she sounded exhausted. Kaito is apparently being no help at all and keeps saying it will all work out.
Angela's son Louis graduated last week and is moving back home until he finds a job. She's thrilled, her husband less so.
Gintaras is the one who brews his own beer. Big into Belgian sours. His girlfriend Shira does pottery on Tuesdays.
Santiago is flying to Bogotá on the 8th for his brother's wedding and back on the 20th. I'm feeding his dog Churro while he's away, starting the morning he leaves.
Remind me to send Aisha and Obi a card before their engagement drinks next Friday at 8.
Mrs Evans from downstairs is moving into a care home near her daughter at the end of the month. She's been in that flat forty years. I'd like to pop round with flowers before she goes.
Alina's leaving party got cancelled because half the office has flu. She's rescheduling for some time in December.
Obi said the proposal was planned for months. His mum knew, his best man knew, and nobody slipped up.
Simone has her first viewing on her own since the breakup this Saturday at 11. I said I'd go with her.
Need to call the letting agent tomorrow morning about the deposit, then measure the bedroom for the wardrobe.

Jaya and her husband are renewing their vows on their twentieth anniversary in May. Small ceremony in Goa, then a party back here the following weekend. She asked if I'd say a few words at the party. Need to start thinking about that early, I'm terrible at speeches. Their daughter Aditi is flying back from Toronto for it, which Jaya keeps saying is the real present.
Mustafa's housewarming is the Saturday after he moves in. He wants board games, not drinks, which suits me.

Callum's grandad passed away last Tuesday. The funeral is on Thursday at 2pm and the wake is at the rugby club afterwards. Callum is holding up but his mum is struggling. Text him that morning. I'll go to the wake for an hour afterwards but can't stay late because of work the next day. His grandad was the one who taught us all to play cribbage.
Theo said Ellie has been dropping hints about a weekend in Paris for their anniversary. He's thinking of booking it as a surprise.
Chantal Kim works in conveyancing, so she's the person to ask about the survey.
Björn's partner Aditi is pregnant, due in March. They told us at dinner tonight. He's already panicking about the move, since they've only got one bedroom.
Mariam asked how the new place was going. Told her about the damp. She said her cousin is a plasterer.
Beatriz is nervous about the toast at her best friend's wedding on Saturday afternoon. Don't forget to text her good luck that morning and ask how it went the next day.
Elijah has started a new job at the council and moves to Leeds in the new year. His sister Jasmine is taking over his flat lease.
Aleksander's dog Bruno had his operation yesterday afternoon and is home now. Very sorry for himself apparently. Aleksander was up all night with him.
Dinner party at Chiara's on the 15th. She asked everyone to bring a dish from where they grew up. Her flatmate Sana is making jollof.
Housewarming list: wine glasses, extension lead, more chairs. Invites go out tonight for Saturday the 25th at 3pm.

Adebayo and his fiancée viewed a house in Croydon on Tuesday evening and put an offer in the next morning. They hear back from the agent Friday at noon. I should message him Friday afternoon. If it goes through they want to be in before Christmas, which the agent says is optimistic. His fiancée is a nurse and has nights all next week, so he's handling most of the calls himself.
Kaito mentioned he hates surprise parties. Noted for his thirtieth next year.
Dong's moving out of the flat share on the 1st. Needs help carrying the sofa down that morning, so I said I'd be there by 8.
Ellie Wright, my old flatmate from uni, is getting married in Edinburgh next August. Save the date arrived today.
Laila's anniversary dinner went really well apparently, and her husband finally proposed to renew their vows. Should congratulate her properly when I see her on Sunday.
Shira is struggling with the long-distance thing since Gintaras moved to Vilnius. She's visiting him for a week over half term and seems much happier with something to count down to.
Ava mentioned her parents are moving to Spain after her dad retires in the spring. She's not thrilled about it.
Need to RSVP to Naledi and Kaito's wedding by the end of the week. Ceremony at 1pm, reception straight afterwards, and they want dietary requirements.
Uncle Adebayo turned seventy yesterday. Big lunch at his house with all the cousins. He wants us all back for Christmas.

Lovely evening at Angela and Louis's. Their daughter is starting at Glasgow uni in September, and they're already planning to downsize once she's gone. Angela wants a garden more than anything; Louis wants to be near a golf course. Neither of them wants to tell her yet. Their dog Maisie is getting old too, and they're worried she won't cope with a new house. I promised to send Angela the link to that bungalow site.

Gintaras and Shira's engagement party is the Saturday after next at 7. Shira's mum is flying in from Haifa for it, arrives on the Thursday morning. Remind me to ask Shira if her mum needs a lift from the airport. Gintaras is in charge of the music and has promised no Lithuanian folk metal this time. The party is at the tapas place on Queen Street, upstairs room.
Sorted the boxes in the spare room. Kitchen stuff goes first, books last.

Jasmine said her landlord is selling up and she has two months to find somewhere. She's pretty upset about it, especially with her exams in January. I'll ring her on Sunday evening and see if she wants to come flat-hunting with me the week after.
